text: Mara reaches the harbor at dawn and confronts the harbormaster about the missing ledger. She learns the shipment was diverted three nights earlier on Bellamy's order. Rather than confront Bellamy directly, she pockets the receipt and says nothing, letting him think the matter is closed. She leaves before sunrise with the truth folded inside her coat, resolved to watch him a while longer before she decides what to do with what she knows.
